CloudMusicItem.title: Cloud Music Item
CloudMusicItem.description: User-owned cloud-synced favorite song, mood profile, or AI-curated playlist item

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

songId.description: Unique identifier of the song or mood item

title.description: Display title of the song or mood recommendation

category.description: Category tag such as favorite, mood, or ai_playlist

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was synced

/users/{userId}/cloud_items/{itemId}.description: User-scoped cloud music items (favorites, moods, and AI recommendations)
